_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — the single top-level 'Settings' group that menu-layout.json relocates all master-data/config pages (Fiscal Years, Cost centers/objects, Tax config, dunning/matching/reorder rules, cashflow policy, allocation keys, BBV-mapping, XBRL/SBR taxonomies, rates) into. Group id stays 'Configuratie' so existing menu-layout.json relocations keep resolving; the display label is 'Settings'. The legacy section:settings footer 'Settings' item is removed via menu-layout.json#removals and its in-app settings page is folded in here as the 'General' child (a section:settings footer item cannot host children, so the expandable group owns the id and the footer is retired).
_meta.description: Single top-level Settings group: app settings page + all configuration/master-data pages.
